name: Home page shows the brand, services and roadmap
description: Verifies the page presents Synthetic Talent with its three services and four roadmap stages.
expected: The Synthetic Talent name, TikTok, YouTube and Instagram, the three service panels (AI influencer management, Content management, Creator management tool) and the Now, Next, Then and Long term roadmap stages are visible.

name: Introduction chapters play as the visitor scrolls
description: Verifies the introduction shows its four chapters over the studio film as the page scrolls.
steps: Scroll down slowly through the introduction
expected: The introduction shows, in order, 'Virtual creators, managed like real talent.', 'Every creator starts as a signal.', 'Made for the vertical screen.' and 'A roster, run like an agency.', each in a dark caption box with a green bar on its left, over a dark studio image with green light. After the last caption scrolls away, the white Results panel (27,746 views) slides in from the right over the film while the film pans left; scrolling on continues down into the By creator table.

name: Roster shows each AI creator labelled as AI-generated
description: Verifies the Meet the roster link reaches the influencer showcase and that every creator is clearly labelled as AI-generated.
steps: Click Meet the roster in the header
expected: The Roster section shows three creator cards: Juno Ferro (Football), Wren Ashby (Comedy & fashion) and AI Cleared (AI news). Each card shows its image or video with an 'AI-generated' label, its TikTok, Instagram and YouTube handles, and an 'AI-generated character' or 'AI-generated channel' badge. The section note says every creator is an AI character.

name: Results show the roster's real figures with the time period
description: Verifies the Results link reaches the results section and that the figures and date range are shown.
expected: The Results section comes straight after the introduction, before the roster. It states the period 16 Sep to 4 Oct 2026 and shows 27,746 views, 143 posts, 223 likes and 7 comments. The By creator table lists AI Cleared, Juno Ferro and Wren Ashby with their posts, views, likes, comments, shares, saves and followers, and the Top post from each creator list shows one linked post for each of them, with its thumbnail and view count.

name: Navigation and footer links reach the team, privacy and terms
description: Verifies the header link reaches the team list and the footer links reach the legal sections.
expected: The Team section shows Victor Boateng as Founder, then the Privacy policy section is shown, then the Terms of use section is shown.

name: Page reads cleanly on a phone
description: Verifies the layout stacks on a small screen without sideways scrolling.
steps: Scroll through the Results, Roster, Services and Roadmap sections
expected: The introduction chapters are readable over the studio image, the creator cards and service panels are stacked in one column, the results figures and creator breakdown are readable without a wide table, the roadmap stages are readable, and the page has no horizontal scroll.

name: About Us page explains the company
description: Verifies About Us opens its own page with the company story and links back to the home page.
steps: Click About Us in the header
Click Meet the roster at the bottom of the page
expected: The About Us page shows 'We build AI creators and run them like real talent.', the What we do, How we work and Where we're heading sections, three principles (Always labelled as AI, Platform rules first, Real numbers only) and Victor Boateng as Founder. About Us is highlighted in the header. Meet the roster returns to the home page's roster section.
